name: Four Seasons London at Tower Bridge
positioning: Four Seasons hotel in a restored 1922 heritage building at 10 Trinity Square in the City of London, near Tower Bridge and the Tower of London
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Tower Bridge and the Tower of London
Guests who want a spa with a hammam in the city

facts.text: The hotel is at 10 Trinity Square, London, EC3N 4AJ.
The hotel is in an original 1922 building by Edwin Cooper.
The building is a Grade II*-listed heritage building.
The hotel has three restaurants: Mei Ume, Rotunda Bar & Lounge and Cooper's Cut.
The nearest tube station is Tower Hill.
The spa has eight treatment rooms.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: You can reach Tower Bridge and the Tower of London within five to 10 minutes on foot.
Mei Ume serves Chinese and Japanese cuisine.
Afternoon tea curated by Lily Vanilli is served at Rotunda Bar & Lounge.
The spa has an authentic hammam.
Grand Heritage Suites have ceilings of up to five metres.

considerations.text: Spa facilities are open from 6:30 am to 8:00 pm.
Airport meet-and-greet service is available at a supplemental cost.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
